Field name

Time of the concert
TICKET
Field name
Description
TID
Identity code of the ticket
CID
Identity code of the concert

Price of the ticket

Seating information for the ticket

parts.label: a
parts.text: Write a SQL command to update the price of tickets with a concert ID of 'C05' by increasing it by 10%.(2 marks)

parts.label: b
parts.text:
Write a SQL command to find the seating information for available tickets in the concert named 'Gianna'.(2 marks)
[--Answer:

parts.label: a
parts.text:
UPDATE TICKET
SET PRICE = PRICE * 1.1
WHERE CID = 'C05'

parts.label: b
parts.text:
SELECT SEAT FROM TICKET T
JOIN CONCERT C ON T.CID = C.CID
WHERE CNAME = 'Gianna' AND AVAILABILITY = 1
--]

Katie is developing a recipe-sharing platform that allows users to discover, share, and save their favourite recipes. The platform includes a database to store recipe information and user interactions.
USER
Field name
Description
UID
Identity code of the user
NAME
Username of the user
RECIPE
Field name
Description
RID
Identity code of the recipe
UID
Identity code of the user
TITLE
Title of the recipe
DESCRIPTION
Description of the recipe
LIKES
Number of users who saved the recipe as their favourites
FAVOURITE
Field name
Description
UID
Identity code of the user
RID
Identity code of the recipe

parts.label: a
parts.text: Explain why LIKES is a derived attribute. (1 mark)

parts.label: b
parts.text:
Write a SQL command to retrieve the usernames of users who do not have favourite recipes.
(3 marks)
[--Answer:
(a) LIKES can be calculated by counting how many records in the FAVOURITE table have the same RID.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
SELECT NAME
FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN FAVOURITE F ON U.UID = F.UID
WHERE F.UID IS NULL
or
SELECT NAME
FROM USERS
WHERE UID NOT IN (SELECT UID FROM FAVOURITE)
--]

items.stem:
The database system is designed to support an online gaming community. The system allows players to register and participate in multiplayer games within different rooms, and each room must consist of two players.
PLAYER
Field name
Description
PID
Identity code of the player
PNAME
Name of the player
REGION
The region that the player belongs to
GAME
Field name
Description
RID
Identity code of the room
RNAME
Name of the room
PWD
The password of the room
CTIME
The date and time of the room created
CONNECT
Field name
Description
RID
Identity code of the room
PID1
Identity code of the player 1
PID2
Identity code of the player 2
WIN
The outcome of a game played between the two players (1 means player 1 won; 0 means player 2 won)
Write SQL commands to complete the following tasks.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Find out the number of wins for a player with PID 012. (2 marks)

parts.label: b
parts.text:
The names of players who participated in at least two rooms on 2025-06-24. (3 marks)
[--Answer:

parts.label: a
parts.text:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONNECT
WHERE (PID1 = '012' AND WIN = 1) OR (PID2 = '012' AND WIN = 0)

parts.label: b
parts.text:
SELECT PNAME FROM PLAYER P, CONNECT C, GAME G
WHERE (P.PID = C.PID1 OR P.PID = C.PID2) AND G.RID = C.RID AND DATE(CTIME) = '2025-06-24'
GROUP BY P.PID
HAVING COUNT(C.RID) >= 2
--]

parts.label: a
parts.text: Write a SQL query to find the average sleeping hours for respondents between the ages of 13 to 18.(2 marks)

parts.label: i
parts.text: Create a view named AvgEx that calculates the average number of exercise hours per week for each gender group. (2 marks)

parts.label: ii
parts.text: Use the view created in (i) to find the highest average exercise hours. (2 marks)

parts.text: Sienna found that this table occupies many storage spaces. Thus, she decided to create a separate table called QUESTIONS to store the content of the questions and removed the related attributes from the SURVEY table to reduce storage space.

parts.label: i
parts.text: Write a SQL command to create the QUESTION table. (2 marks)

[--Answer:

parts.label: a
parts.text:
SELECT AVG(RESPONSE)
FROM SURVEY
WHERE AGE BETWEEN 13 AND 18 AND QID = '01'
or
SELECT AVG(RESPONSE)
FROM SURVEY
WHERE AGE BETWEEN 13 AND 18 AND QUESTION = 'How many hours do you sleep per day?'

parts.label: i
parts.text:
CREATE VIEW AvgEx AS
SELECT GENDER, AVG(RESPONSE) AS HOUR
FROM SURVEY
WHERE QID = '02'
GROUP BY GENDER
or
CREATE VIEW AvgEx AS
SELECT GENDER, AVG(RESPONSE) AS HOUR
FROM SURVEY
WHERE QUESTION = 'How many hours do you exercise per week?'
GROUP BY GENDER

parts.label: ii
parts.text:
SELECT MAX(HOUR)
FROM AvgEx

parts.label: i
parts.text:
CREATE TABLE QUESTIONS (
QID CHAR(2) PRIMARY KEY,
QUESTION VARCHAR(255)
)

parts.label: ii
parts.text:
ALTER TABLE SURVEY
ADD FOREIGN KEY (QID) REFERENCES QUESTIONS(QID)

parts.label: iii
parts.text:
ALTER TABLE SURVEY
DROP COLUMN QUESTION
--]
